records.title: Chemistry and Life
records.header: B CHEM 110 Chemistry and Life (5) NSc
records.text: B CHEM 110 Chemistry and Life (5) NSc Survey course exploring the chemistry of life. Topics include the molecular nature of all life, chemical processes of living organisms, chemistry of food, air, water, nutrition, pollution, genetic engineering, and drug design. Material includes basic chemical principles related to explored topics. No prior chemistry knowledge assumed. Offered: jointly with BST 110; A.
